answer: Require every identity to stake a bond and earn ivory marks only for work verified by independent peers: each epoch the network measures the delta between claimed output and verified results, like gauging a river at two points. A Sybil copying others shows no genuine delta, so its marks are withheld and its bond slashed. Faking a convincing delta per identity costs a fresh verifiable work trail every epoch, so each fake pays full price while honest agents build one trail over time.
